result.title: BioCL-POS: Biological Completer-aware Learning with Predictive Observation Selection - A Wild Ginseng Study
result.summary: Growers and traders rely on root morphology to assess wild ginseng, yet breakage can obscure important structural traits. We study point cloud completion to provide geometric references for morphological analysis. Does providing more observed points always improve 3D completion? We test whether selected subsets improve recovery of the original missing region while keeping the pretrained completer fixed. We introduce BioCL-POS, an external selector that predicts how the completer responds to candidate inputs. For each candidate, we predict the displacement and distance from shared spatial locations to the nearest points in its completion. We use these spatial responses to estimate recovery quality and supervise them with measurements from actual completions. At inference, we select an input from the observed geometry and run the completer once. We evaluate four frozen completers on controlled gaps in ginseng and tree data at 5%,10%, and 20% omission, and examine 30% omission on ginseng. At 5--20% omission, we outperform full-input completion and all five alternative selectors on both datasets with all four completers. We achieve lower mean reconstruction error and higher mean F-score and coverage. We thus show that selecting observations can improve geometric recovery without retraining the completer, providing more accurate geometric references for subsequent morphological analysis.

AI.brief_summary: 面向野山参根形分析的点云补全，提出外部选择器 BioCL-POS：对每个候选观测子集预测固定补全器的响应（共享空间位置到补全结果最近点的位移与距离），据此估计缺失区域恢复质量并挑选输入观测，使冻结补全器单次运行即优于全输入。
AI.relevance_reason: 「先预测冻结模型对候选证据的响应、再选择观测」与 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选、证据获取和贡献估计有明确方法联系，可供核查该响应信号能否用于多模态 latent 推理的输入选择与计算分配。
